text:
If you're trying to salvage an outdoor Thursday, the widespread early rain has backed off, but the promised sunshine is taking its time. Burlington is mostly cloudy at 73, feeling a little more humid at 74, with a south-southwest wind around 13 mph. Some breaks should develop this afternoon, and the official call is for a high near 81, but scattered showers remain possible. The forecast only carries a 30% chance, while the models are considerably wetter, so I'd keep a rain jacket close rather than betting the whole afternoon on dry weather.

On the lake, south winds around 15 to 20 knots should ease, with waves subsiding from 1 to 3 feet toward nearly calm. Tonight turns partly cloudy with a low near 63. Friday looks cooler and partly sunny, topping out around 78, with a slight shower chance midafternoon and another chance after 7. Enjoy the improving afternoon, but keep flexible outdoor plans and don't leave the jacket behind.
